13:5412.name: Generali Travel Insurance (GTI) is a big-revenue site ($30M+ annually) where even small changes in conversion rate can positively or negatively impact revenue by millions of dollars. Our team was tasked with updating the design, accessibility, and speed of the site without disrupting that revenue. My role within this context was to provide direction at a leadership level and remove obstacles so that the rest of the team can work smoothly. Visual designs by Enia Amlashi
